```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(factoextra)
library(ggrepel)
library(GGally)
```

# 1.1 Load GEO data
```{r}
gse <- getGEO("GSE163151")
```

# 1.2 Extract metadata
```{r}
metadata <- pData(gse$GSE163151_series_matrix.txt.gz)
```

# 1.3 Check metadata structure
```{r}
dim(metadata)
colnames(metadata)
head(metadata)
```

# 1.4 Check sample titles
```{r}
head(metadata$title, 20)
```

# 1.5 Check sample type
```{r}
table(metadata$source_name_ch1)
```

# 1.6 Find all characteristics columns
```{r}
char_cols <- grep(
  "characteristics_ch1",
  colnames(metadata),
  value = TRUE
)

char_cols
```

# 1.7 
```{r}
condition_table <- metadata |>  
  separate(
    title,
    into = c("condition", "sample_id"),
    sep = "-",
    extra = "merge"
  )

condition_table$condition


```
